name: @dsh-chamber/dsh-chamber-client-ui-browser
description: Chamber remote-browser client plugin (design 28, W0 skeleton): the right-sidebar launcher over SSH loopback forwards — an address bar (http(s), path; remote 127.0.0.1/localhost) plus the per-source forward list. It never embeds a page, never opens a gateway tunnel and never re-implements the dsh host surface: a public URL goes through the existing system-browser link leg, and a remote loopback URL is opened by the trusted main process (openInBrowser), not by this package
